dependency_rules: Each physical H lane distributes128bits to each of4compute copies.
Shared V read lanes1/2 broadcast1024bits to all copies; other-copy V requests are suppressed.
HLAYOUT1 writeq combines8BF16 words from each of4compute copies; all valids must lockstep.
K/W returns unicast to own copy outside shared V phase.
Descriptor read uses physical q0 lane0; status/command/reset/clock ports are not included.
die_owns_assignment: No coordinates/layers assigned here. die_live and vm_stream jointly own facing W/E pin plan; no extra M6/M7/M8/M9 signal grant.
